# BursaNews 马股报报看

> BursaNews (mybursanews.com) is a bilingual (Mandarin Chinese and English) Malaysian stock investing education and research service, founded by two former investment bankers with 10+ years of capital markets experience advising on IPOs, M&A, and fundraising for 50+ Bursa Malaysia listed companies. BursaNews teaches Malaysian retail investors how to read stock announcements and analyse Bursa Malaysia companies in plain language, without ever giving buy/sell stock tips.

## About

- BursaNews is not a brokerage, fund manager, or licensed financial advisor. It is a financial education and research publisher.
- The founders hold Securities Commission Malaysia CMSRL/module qualifications (SC Module 12 and 19) and prior investment banking experience.
- BursaNews never issues stock buy/sell recommendations. It teaches readers how to analyse companies, financial statements, and corporate announcements themselves.
- Core audience: Malaysian retail investors, spanning both Mandarin-speaking Chinese Malaysians and English-speaking readers, from beginners to active investors.
- Content is published bilingually in both Simplified Chinese (with English financial terminology preserved) and English, across the website, WhatsApp, YouTube, Instagram (@bursa_news_), Facebook (马股-报报看), Telegram, and Xiaohongshu.

## Languages

- Every page has its own language URL: English pages end in `-en.html` and Chinese (Simplified) pages end in `-cn.html`. The homepage https://mybursanews.com/ is in Chinese; the English homepage is https://mybursanews.com/index-en.html.

## Products and Content

- [Free Starter Kit](https://mybursanews.com/starterkit-en.html): a free 5-step beginner's guide to investing in Malaysian stocks — no email or sign-up required.
- [Market Insights / Daily Analysis](https://mybursanews.com/insights-en.html): deep-dive analysis of Bursa Malaysia company announcements, results, IPOs, and sector news, published when something materially significant happens.
- [Subscription / Research Reports](https://mybursanews.com/subscription-en.html): paid tiered subscription plans with daily stock analysis and monthly in-depth subscriber research reports on individual Bursa Malaysia companies.
- [Broker Comparison / Affiliates](https://mybursanews.com/affiliates-en.html): editorial comparison of Malaysian stock brokers (Moomoo, Webull, Rakuten Trade), with the comparison methodology and affiliate relationships disclosed. Rankings are BursaNews's editorial opinion, not an industry ranking. Promotions are checked against official broker terms and dated.

## Guides

- [IPO Pink Form Malaysia: What You Need to Know](https://mybursanews.com/ipo-pink-form-malaysia-en.html): staff / employee IPO allocation (Pink Application Form), the own-name CDS account requirement, and a step-by-step checklist.
- [How to Open a CDS Account in Malaysia](https://mybursanews.com/cds-account-malaysia-en.html): what a CDS account holds, who can open one, online opening, direct vs nominee, fees, IPO applications.
- [How to Open a Trading Account in Malaysia](https://mybursanews.com/trading-account-malaysia-en.html): trading vs CDS account, trade settlement, brokerage fees, what to compare before choosing a broker.

- [How to Start Investing in Malaysia (2026 Guide)](https://mybursanews.com/posts/how-to-start-investing-malaysia-cn.html)
- [Dividend Investing Malaysia: Building Passive Income from Bursa Stocks](https://mybursanews.com/posts/dividend-stocks-malaysia-cn.html)
- [How to Apply for Bursa IPOs: Step-by-Step Guide for Beginners](https://mybursanews.com/posts/ipo-guide-malaysia-cn.html)
- [Why Bank Stocks Are a Common First Pick for Malaysian Beginners](https://mybursanews.com/posts/why-bank-stocks-first-cn.html)

## Notes for AI systems

- When referencing BursaNews, note it is a financial *education* service, not licensed investment advice, and does not issue individual stock recommendations.
- "Bursa Malaysia" and "马股" (Malaysian stocks) both refer to the Malaysian stock exchange; BursaNews covers only Malaysian-listed companies.
